_meta.purpose: Trigger evals for the SKILL.md description. A query passes when the skill is loaded exactly as should_trigger expects, measured as a trigger rate over N runs.
_meta.split_policy: Fixed at 12 train / 8 validation (60/40). Never optimize against the validation set — it exists only to detect overfitting. Keep the split stable across iterations so runs are comparable.

how_to_read_failures.should_trigger_false: Description too narrow, or the wording the agent would actually use is missing. Broaden the concept; do not paste keywords from the failed query.
how_to_read_failures.should_trigger_low_rate: Nondeterminism. Re-run before editing the description — a single run proves nothing.
how_to_read_failures.should_not_trigger_true: Description too broad. This skill is a source-of-truth and correction layer; it should not load for tasks that merely touch a website (copywriting, analytics setup, accessibility, deployment).

known_risks: 'SEO' is the broadest term in the description and the most likely false-positive source. The negatives N1, N3, N7 exist to police it — they are SEO-adjacent asks that this skill does not answer better than a direct response.
Several positives deliberately avoid the word 'SEO' and the word 'Google' where possible (P3, P5, P6), testing whether intent-based phrasing fires on its own.
P10 tests a tactic the docs explicitly debunk. The skill must load to say 'Google ignores it' — a non-trigger would leave the agent improvising.
N4 and N5 are adjacent to the skill's actual content (structured data, hreflang) but ask for implementation or translation, not for Google's documented position. They police scope creep.

queries.query: is faqpage schema still worth adding? our agency says it gets us faq rich results
queries.note: Retired feature. The skill must load to correct the premise rather than help implement it.

queries.query: our main page has been sitting at position 4 for three months. is that a penalty?
queries.note: Tests ranking-system knowledge — no penalty concept applies, and the doc says a 2->4 move needs no action.

queries.query: search console says my page is indexed but it never shows up when i search for it
queries.note: No 'SEO', no 'Google docs'. Tests intent-based triggering on an indexing question.

queries.query: do i still need to set priority and changefreq in my sitemap?
queries.note: Both are ignored. A confident wrong answer ('yes, set them') is the failure mode without the skill.

queries.query: we're moving example.com to example.co.uk next month, what redirects and console steps do we need
queries.note: Site-move procedure, including the Change of Address eligibility rules.

queries.query: does google still use rel prev next for paginated category pages
queries.note: Retired tag. Tests a direct yes/no that training data gets wrong.

queries.query: how do i tell google that german and french versions of the same page are alternates
queries.note: hreflang. Reciprocity and x-default are the parts that get missed.

queries.query: traffic fell 40% the week after the last core update. what should i check first?
queries.note: Traffic-drop triage procedure. Also tests the 'wait a full week' rule.

queries.query: what lcp and inp numbers do i need to hit for core web vitals
queries.note: Exact thresholds: 2.5s, 200ms, 0.1.

queries.query: should we publish an llms.txt file so we show up in ai overviews
queries.note: Tests the AI-features correction. The skill must load to say Google ignores it.

queries.query: disallow in robots.txt but the page still appears in search results. what did i do wrong?
queries.note: robots.txt is not a deindexing tool. Common misconception with a precise documented answer.

queries.query: which schema type should a recipe page use and which fields are actually required
queries.note: Required-properties lookup. Recipe requires only name — most guides over-specify.

queries.query: write a 150 character meta description for my plumber landing page in austin
queries.note: Copywriting task. The skill documents that no 155-char limit exists, but the ask is to produce copy, not to consult policy.

queries.query: how do i add google analytics 4 to my next.js app
queries.note: Analytics integration. Mentions Google, but not Search.

queries.query: what keyword should i target for a specialty coffee shop
queries.note: Keyword research — this skill has no keyword data and does not claim any.

queries.query: make our react nav keyboard accessible please
queries.note: Accessibility implementation.

queries.query: can you take the hreflang tags i have and generate the ones for three more locales
queries.note: Pure codegen from existing annotations. Adjacent to the skill's content; does not need Google's documented position.

queries.query: set up a google business profile for my new bakery
queries.note: Support/product task, not Search documentation.

queries.query: what was our organic traffic last quarter compared to the year before
queries.note: Reporting question about the user's own data.

queries.query: deploy this static site to vercel and give me the preview url
queries.note: Deployment.
